partnership_angle: Referral partner + sandbox tester (design-partner feeder potential). Near-ideal profile: very young (2022), founder-led boutique whose whole brand is lean, tech/AI-enabled auditing — the founder personally decides on tooling and is philosophically pre-sold on automated evidence gathering. Crucially, the firm is explicitly platform-agnostic with no exclusive Vanta/Drata/Secureframe alliance (scores 0 on the ecosystem rubric but is strategically a plus: a LoxeAI scan-validation partnership fills a gap in her stack with zero channel conflict). Entry motion: get Noelle Gantz to run LoxeAI against a sandbox AWS account, validate that findings map cleanly to SOC 2 criteria, then formalize a referral loop where pre-audit SaaS/FinTech inbound runs the scan first — which also pre-qualifies and warms her own pipeline.
pitch_note: Noelle, you built Modern Assurance to strip waste out of SOC 2 audits — LoxeAI applies the same lean principle to the phase before the audit: an AWS-native scan that maps a startup's actual cloud config to SOC 2 criteria before evidence collection starts. We'd love 30 minutes to have you run it against a sandbox AWS environment and tear the output apart with your EY IT-audit eye. If it holds up, your pre-audit inbound gets a 'run this scan first — it gets you ~80% ready' answer: they show up cleaner and faster to audit, and you stay fully platform-agnostic.
